summary: Cooling season demand showed up right on schedule and the account was ready for it. Search campaigns leaned into AC repair intent while the 4-posts-a-week GBP cadence kept the profile active in every service-area neighborhood.
coverSub: A cooling-season snapshot: how search campaigns and a relentless Google Business Profile cadence turned summer AC demand into booked calls.
headline: June is when HVAC accounts earn their keep, and this one did: call volume rose with the heat while search stayed disciplined on cost. One flag remains: LSA verification still needs to clear after the March reset.
snapshotLead: Summer intent arrived and the account caught it. AC repair searches drove the month, with GBP posts keeping the brand visible in every neighborhood we target.
takeaway: Seasonal demand is doing half the work right now, which is exactly when discipline matters most. Keeping cost per call flat during peak season means the account is buying real jobs, not just summer noise.
